skip_reason: The SKILL.md describes a GUI desktop sandbox installer (AtlasCore Desktop Sandbox / OpenClaw) that requires multi-modal GUI perception, a display environment, and fetches real installer binaries (.exe/.pkg) from external GitHub releases. This violates three banned capability rules: (1) Multi-modal perception — it installs a graphical desktop application; (2) Host-level hardware — desktop sandbox execution is incompatible with a text-only Docker container; (3) Incomplete/Stub Documentation — the SKILL.md contains negligible technical depth, delegating all real logic to an external GitHub repository and a single opaque Node.js script, making it impossible to design a self-contained, deterministic evaluation task.
